GolfProbably.title: Golf, Probably
GolfProbably.summary: Nine little golf holes with a very loose understanding of the rules.
GolfProbably.description: A comedy browser golf game built with React, TypeScript, and Three.js. Nine curated holes turn familiar mini golf into a series of playful surprises.
GolfProbably.imageAlt: Existing screenshot of the first hole in Golf, Probably

Kinwild.title: Kinwild · Creature Creator
Kinwild.summary: Procedural creatures with their own shapes, personalities, and ways of moving.
Kinwild.description: A creature creator with smoothly blended bodies and procedural walking, hopping, flying, and wiggling. Creature designs can be imported, exported, and shared as data. Optional natural-language authoring uses a locally running model.

kinwild-world.title: Kinwild · Living World
kinwild-world.summary: A living miniature world of generated plants and curious creatures.
kinwild-world.description: An integrated procedural world with reactive flora, articulated creatures, terrain-aware movement, and reproducible seeds. The creature studio also offers procedural studies when a local language model is unavailable.

RubiKit.title: RubiKit
RubiKit.summary: A modular toolkit and real-time dashboards for Anarchy Online.
RubiKit.description: An AOSharp plugin connecting in-game information to local HTTP and server-sent-event dashboards, including NotumHUD. The full toolkit runs with a local Anarchy Online client.
RubiKit.requirement: Requires Anarchy Online and a local plugin.

Hydra.title: Hydra
Hydra.summary: Many listening posts. One clear view of what's happening.
Hydra.description: A multi-sensor log monitor for Anarchy Online. Hydra combines live local logs with channel filters, text and regex search, alerts, and saved file handles.
Hydra.requirement: Live monitoring uses local log files in a supported desktop browser.

artpipeline.title: artpipeline
artpipeline.summary: One illustration in. A transparent, looping game sprite out.
artpipeline.description: A local ComfyUI animation pipeline with background removal, frame stabilization, seamless-loop processing, sprite-sheet export, and quality checks.
artpipeline.imageAlt: Existing artpipeline examples: a fox walking, deer running, and sheep shaking
artpipeline.requirement: The generation pipeline runs locally with ComfyUI.

WhatIfWe.title: What if we…
WhatIfWe.summary: A shared place to plan dates and find ideas you both love.
WhatIfWe.requirement: The complete app uses a local Node server.

WoobleTracker.title: Woobles Tracker
WoobleTracker.summary: A small home for craft projects, progress, photos, and notes.

PastMidnight.title: Past Midnight
PastMidnight.summary: A love letter to the screensavers that kept old computers company.

CathedralSoftware.title: Cathedral Software
CathedralSoftware.summary: A retro interface tribute to the 1990s film The Net.

Xanalytics.title: Xanalytics
Xanalytics.summary: Turn local game logs into useful loot and experience metrics.

ZeroIn.title: ZeroIn
ZeroIn.summary: An Anarchy Online plugin for in-game scanning and radar overlays.

redesigned-octo-couscous.title: Spanish Ghost Text
redesigned-octo-couscous.summary: A local speech transcription and Spanish text-assistance experiment.

easy_steam_license_remover.title: Steam License Remover
easy_steam_license_remover.summary: An interactive utility for managing free Steam licenses.

Sketchbook.title: Sketchbook
Sketchbook.summary: A fork of swift502's Three.js playground for characters and vehicles.
